opportunities.name_zh: 萩城下町・菊屋橫町白壁與江戶街景
opportunities.best_time: 白天可見光時段（景點當地時間／JST）
opportunities.best_season: 全年；夏蜜柑、秋季和服活動等只在實際存在時作畫面加分，不是基本 Outcome 硬條件

condition_variants.variant_name: 菊屋橫町・白壁／海鼠壁與歷史街巷
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"菊屋横町 Historic Lane Camera Zone","subject":"white plaster / namako walls + gates + preserved Edo-period street context"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 菊屋橫町公共街道可合法步行；白天可見光有效；不得進入私人住宅或阻礙居民／行人動線
condition_variants.required_conditions: 菊屋橫町白壁、海鼠壁、門與歷史街巷脈絡清楚可辨；無足以妨礙步行與手持攝影的強降水
condition_variants.boosters: 柔和散射光；夏蜜柑實際垂出牆面；季節植栽；較少人流時更容易形成乾淨街景
condition_variants.penalties: 強降水；積水／惡劣天候；人流過度壅擠；越界進入私人範圍

viewpoints.note: Official Hagi/JNTO sources identify Kikuya Yokocho as the representative picturesque historic lane. The anchor is the mapped street POI, cross-checked against geotagged photographs along the lane; it is not a fixed tripod point.
viewpoints.name: 萩城下町・菊屋橫町 Historic Lane Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 菊屋橫町約500公尺歷史街巷公共動線；可沿街前後移動尋找白壁、海鼠壁、門與夏蜜柑構圖，不宣稱單一腳架位置。

opportunities.name_zh: 2026 萩・竹灯路物語・菊屋橫町竹燈夜景
opportunities.best_season: 僅已發布的2026年活動日期；不得把年度活動自動推論到未發布年份或一般夜晚

condition_variants.variant_name: 2026 竹灯路・菊屋橫町歷史街巷燭光
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"菊屋横町 Historic Lane Camera Zone","subject":"bamboo candle lanterns + historic white-wall streetscape"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 日期必須為2026/10/9、10/10或10/11；時間必須在18:00–21:00 JST官方活動時段；官方活動實際舉行；公共街道可合法進入
condition_variants.required_conditions: 竹燈實際點亮並與菊屋橫町歷史街景同框可辨；無足以破壞活動與攝影的惡劣降水
condition_variants.boosters: 和服活動參與者在合法且取得適當同意時可增加時代氛圍；乾燥天氣；較低人流
condition_variants.penalties: 非官方活動日期／時段；活動變更或取消；強降水；人流過度壅擠

viewpoints.note: The official 2026 night-tour route explicitly passes through Kikuya Yokocho during the Bamboo Lamp Festival. Same historic-lane Camera Zone as P01; the night subject exists only during the verified event window.
viewpoints.name: 2026 竹灯路・菊屋橫町 Night Event Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 官方2026夜間路線明確經過菊屋橫町；實際竹燈分布可沿城下町街道延伸，因此此 anchor 表示街巷 Camera Zone，不是單一燈籠位置。

navigation_target.source: B32 Hagi City/JNTO historic-lane research + mapped Kikuya Yokocho street anchor

note_i18n.zh-TW: 此點為公共歷史街巷的代表進入錨點，可作為步行導航目的地。
note_i18n.en: This is a representative public historic-lane access anchor suitable for walking navigation.
note_i18n.ja: 公共の歴史街路への代表的なアクセス基準点で、徒歩ナビの目的地として使用できます。
